# 00000002061

**UA-11 ★** — source: 54_泛代数与范畴论.md

**English.** Definition: The sublattice of the lattice of varieties generated by bands (idempotent semigroups). Conjecture: The sublattice count is an explicit Fibonacci-type formula (the number is F_{2n−1}); the count is controlled by the combinatorial covering of left-zero/right-zero/rectangular bands.

**中文。** 定义：带(band,幂等半群)簇的子格指簇格中由带生成的子格。猜想：子格计数为 Fibonacci 型显式公式(数 = F_{2n-1});计数由左零/右零/矩形带的组合覆盖控制。
